list: The official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them before this bounty opened; names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them.
sourcesNote: Every guide below is written for this entry from the official description. Sources for the facts: Exophase (official name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (PSN progress counts). Where a place or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops when the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no shortcut. Work the roadmap in order, clear the missable strand finales before the final mission, then mop up activities and collectibles. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the game's first mission, so it comes naturally as you start the story — just follow the opening beats. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Chapters unlock in order as you play the main missions, so keep following the story until the chapter closes. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Play the main missions in order and the chapter trophy pops when the chapter ends. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Keep working the main missions; the trophy is the chapter's own ending. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. This is the last chapter before the finale, so it pops as you push the main story toward its end. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This gold is the story's own ending — it pops when the last mission is done. Before you start it, finish the missable ally strands and stranger strands, since they may close once the story ends. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story missions are marked on the map; play this one through and the trophy is yours. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-mission set piece, so it comes up as you play the story — finish the heist and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission marker and play it through to the end. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a main-mission beat, so it arrives in the story order — finish it and the trophy is yours. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport takedown is a main-mission set piece; play it through and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main-mission beat late in the story order; finish the operation and the trophy is yours. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Completion counts story missions, stranger strands, activities and collectibles, so this is a late-game gold: finish the story, then work this checklist. The in-game stats page shows your percentage as you go. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like. Stunts add up across free roam, so fold them into normal driving: take jumps, thread traffic and catch air whenever you can, and the count climbs on its own. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything early — races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting, drone races and challenges — one try of each is enough, and it teaches you what each activity is. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range lists each challenge's own targets and times — practice the ones you miss and return until every challenge shows gold. A steady aim beats a fast trigger finger. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line, then win at all 14 — the race menu shows which locations you have already won, so work through the missing ones. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but they must be 20 different events — vary the races instead of repeating the same one, and the count climbs. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge, watch Cal's catch, and out-fish him — steady reeling beats rushing, and a calm hand lands more fish. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet, play it through to its end, and the trophy pops — the easiest activity trophy in the game. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableWhy: Ally strand finale — finish it before the final mission, as ally strands can close once the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Ally strands can close as the story moves on, so do Andy's missions as they appear rather than leaving them for after the story. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list). This is our own advice from the official description — the description names the strand but no exact mission list.
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableWhy: Ally strand finale — finish it before the final mission, as ally strands can close once the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Like the other ally finales, Kenton's strand can close as the story moves on — play his missions as they appear and finish the strand before the finale. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list). This is our own advice from the official description — the description names the strand but no exact mission list.
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableWhy: Ally strand finale — finish it before the final mission, as ally strands can close once the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of five ally finales — do his missions as they appear and finish the strand before the final mission. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list). This is our own advice from the official description — the description names the strand but no exact mission list.
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableWhy: Stranger strands can close once the story passes them — start them early and finish 8 full strands before the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear around the map; finish 8 full strands. Start them early — strands can close once the story passes them, so do not leave them all for after the finale. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableWhy: Ally strand finale — finish it before the final mission, as ally strands can close once the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of five ally finales — play his missions as they appear and finish the strand before the final mission. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list). This is our own advice from the official description — the description names the strand but no exact mission list.
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableWhy: Ally strand finale — finish it before the final mission, as ally strands can close once the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of five ally finales — do his missions as they appear and finish the strand before the final mission. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list). This is our own advice from the official description — the description names the strand but no exact mission list.
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet places around the map; visit all 18 and meditate at each — fold them into your exploration so none is left for a special trip. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt opens, then track the animal it names and take it down — the strand tells you what to hunt and where to look. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets — three complete sets earns the silver. Check each set's progress as you go so you know which cards are still missing. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It spots are spread across the state; work through them as you explore and the count climbs. It is a long grind, so chip away at it between story beats rather than saving all 100 for the end. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side tasks; any 50 completions across any mix of them earns this. Play the activities you enjoy and the count takes care of itself. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableWhy: Needs your partner beside you — partner segments are chapter-bound, so do it while a partner is with you.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you, and partner segments are chapter-bound, so do this while a partner is with you: build a 4-star wanted level together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableWhy: Needs your partner beside you — partner segments are chapter-bound, so do it while a partner is with you.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Same partner window as Hot Together: hit three shops in a row with your partner and keep the wanted level alive between them — plan a short route between three close shops and move fast. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts — cars, bikes, boats, planes — so try anything you find instead of sticking to one ride. The discovery count climbs fast once you start sampling. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a busy shootout with a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — a crowded firefight is the place to try. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport, take a plane and leave on your own schedule — an unscheduled takeoff is the whole joke. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the trophy is tied to the Rhino tank. Seek a Rhino out and get into a tank situation; the description gives no exact spot, so any Rhino encounter should do. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — and get out clean. Patience beats speed here; wait for the right moment instead of rushing the counter. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each with a clean escape — plan the getaway before you go in, and count the vaults as you finish them. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, take it down, grab the cash and lose the heat — a fast car waiting nearby makes the escape easy. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you travel; visit every named area until the counter reads 52. Mop up the last few areas deliberately at the end of the game. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang, nine gangs in all — the map marks gang operations, so work through the list and check off each gang as you hit it. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet trophy, and a good breather between the loud ones. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a showroom's front in style — the description gives no exact spot, so any vehicle showroom should do. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley — follow through on the throw and the trophy is yours. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableWhy: Reads like a single partner moment — play partner activities as they come, since the description gives no detail.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives no detail — it reads like a single partner moment, so play partner activities as they come and watch for a standout moment. Not yet pinned down; our own reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks choices up to 500, and they accumulate across the whole game — keep playing and deciding, and this is a late-game mop-up rather than something to chase early. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description gives no detail — it reads like succeeding on a second try at something. Try, fail, try again: the charm is in the retry. Not yet pinned down; our own reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description gives no detail — it reads like witnessing something strange in Leonida. Keep an eye out for odd events as you explore; the strange ones are the ones to remember. Not yet pinned down; our own reading of the official description. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — line the car up, swing as you pass, and the pins fall. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Robberies feed this one, so it pairs with the vault and truck jobs. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food — until the total passes $100,000. Buy what you need as you play and the total takes care of itself. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market; the property menu shows which you own, so work through the missing ones as your cash allows. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or register vehicles in the Scooter Bros app until 10 are on file — any ten vehicles will do, so register what you drive. Sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN progress count).
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies
